title: Redridge Mountains
body: The Redridge Mountains rise east of Elwynn, red stone ridges and wooded slopes gathered around Lake Everstill, all of it sovereign land of the King of Stormwind. The Horde overran these hills in the First War, and Lakeshire was rebuilt only after the Second. Now war has come back. Blackrock orcs out of the Burning Steppes, aided by the renegade warlock Morganth, have taken Stonewatch Keep and raid everything north of Lakeshire, gnolls hold the hills, and the town begs Stormwind for soldiers.

title: Lakeshire
body: Lakeshire is the heart of Redridge, a town on the western shore of Lake Everstill. Taken by the Horde in the First War and rebuilt after the Second, it is under siege again, held by a handful of guards under Marshal Marris while Magistrate Solomon presides over the town court. The inn stays open even as its bottles run dry, and the Everstill Bridge into town, blown out in the fighting, waits on iron that never seems to arrive.

title: Render's Camp
body: Where the road climbs out of Redridge toward the Burning Steppes, the Blackrock clan has made camp just west of the pass. From Render's Camp the champions who lead each Blackrock unit direct the war on Lakeshire, and within it lies Render's Rock, a cave held by the clan's strongest warriors. Here the orcs keep their prisoners, among them Corporal Keeshan of the 12th Sabre Regiment, taken alive at Stonewatch Keep.

title: Stonewatch Keep
body: Stonewatch Keep once guarded the people of Lakeshire. Then the Blackrock orcs came over the mountains, and with the warlock Morganth's dark magic behind them they stormed it; most of the regiment that held it died in the fighting. Warlord Gath'Ilzogg has made the keep his stronghold, and shadowcasters bearing demon-tainted orbs guard its halls. Beside it stands Stonewatch Tower, the one watch tower still intact.

title: Galardell Valley
body: Galardell Valley runs through the eastern foothills of Redridge, and it belongs to the Shadowhide gnolls. The Shadowhide answer to the warlock Morganth, who speaks to them through the enchanted pendants they wear, and their camps crowd the valley under Lieutenant Fangore, the strongest of them. By the Law of Lakeshire, aiding a criminal of the kingdom is punishable by death, and every Shadowhide who serves Morganth is to be hunted down.

title: Tower of Ilgalar
body: At the eastern edge of Redridge stands the Tower of Ilgalar, a mage tower now claimed by Morganth. Banished from Stormwind for turning to the dark arts, he carried off a powerful tome, Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic, and keeps it here. Shadowhide darkweavers guard the grounds, demonic servants roam the halls, and displays of dragon bones hint at some study of dragons. An old lion statue has kept lonely watch over the tower for decades.

title: Magistrate Solomon
body: Magistrate Solomon is the elected leader of Lakeshire and judge of its court. With orcs at Stonewatch and gnolls in every hill, the town is under constant siege, and he is certain that without reinforcements it will fall. He has written his most urgent report to General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind, and meanwhile posts bounties on the kingdom's enemies and enforces the Law of Lakeshire against all who aid them.

parts.body: The general's answer was warm: reinforcements would march as soon as the king gave word. Solomon found it a mystery. Something is amiss in the kingdom, he said, and he feared this was only the beginning.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Magistrate_Solomon (elected ruler, judge of the Court of Lakeshire)

parts.body: No soldiers came. When Westfall's militia and Darkshire's Night Watch both wrote back that Stormwind had abandoned them too, Solomon began to speak openly of treachery, and means to learn what is wrong in Stormwind.

title: Gath'Ilzogg
body: Gath'Ilzogg, Warlord of the Blackrock Clan, led the assault on Stonewatch Keep and the raids that have kept Lakeshire penned in ever since. With Morganth's magic behind them his warriors took the keep, and he plots the clan's next blows from within it, a black dragon whelp called Singe at his side. His executioner, Targorr the Dread, who tortured captured defenders on a whim, now sits in the Stormwind Stockade.

parts.body: When the warlord's head was laid before Magistrate Solomon, he named it vindication for the innocents Gath'Ilzogg had killed, and the first step in winning Stonewatch Keep back for Stormwind.

title: Morganth
body: Morganth was one of three mages who studied together in Stormwind until he fell to the dark arts; urged to turn back, he could not, and he was banished. He settled in the Tower of Ilgalar and lent his magic to the Blackrock orcs in their assault on Stonewatch Keep, and the Shadowhide gnolls take his commands through enchanted pendants. In Elwynn Forest his rival Theocritus watches him from afar.

parts.body: Through the Eye of Azora, Theocritus has seen the alliance that took Stonewatch sour: Morganth is now in conflict with the orcs of the keep, though the cause is still a mystery.
sources: quest 1938 description (three mages, fall, banishment, the treatise)

parts.body: Further watching uncovered his purpose. Morganth searches for the Scythe of Elune, and Theocritus fears he may already have found it.
sources: quest 1938 description (three mages, fall, banishment, the treatise)

parts.body: Morganth fell in the Tower of Ilgalar among his demonic servants, and his Pendant of Shadow went to Theocritus, who declared Stormwind saved from a grave peril.
